comments.author: Tico
comments.body: I already have invested 10M in each dutch city, 11,5 in Amsterdam, but the shipwright don't show the recipe. Please, someone can help me to open this recipe?

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: You need to actually have R18 Casting or Handicrafts (depending on what panel type you what to make), AND have R18 Shipbuilding, either on you or from a fleet member. If you dont have both... recipe will not appear.
